review.purpose: Count actual certificate identities independently from assignment rows and retain a deduplicated work list.
review.finding: Three selected assignments represent two fingerprints because api-primary and api-standby share certificate bytes. All eight assignments remain in the denominator, including one with no observed certificate. PEM/DER fingerprints also match SQL SHA256 of original DER.

review.purpose: Compare parsed subject names with issuers to distinguish self-issued naming from signature validation.
review.finding: All six subject/issuer comparisons return true. The notebook explicitly calls these self-issued names, not proof of a signature or trust; the separate deterministic fixture generator establishes their test self-signing.

review.purpose: Use issuer names together with subjects to explain the provenance limits of this synthetic inventory.
review.finding: The six comparisons agree; no external issuer or trust path is inferred from equal names. Certificate byte identities remain fingerprints, not these names.

review.purpose: Exclude future-validity material from a fixed historical planning assessment even if its expiry enters a wider horizon.
review.finding: The future certificate starts ten days after the fixed assessment and remains separately classified. Returned UTC wall-clock timestamps are not interpreted in local timezone; current-clock cert_is_expired is deliberately not used.

review.purpose: Select time-valid certificates expiring on or before an inclusive planning horizon.
review.finding: The seven-day shared certificate and fourteen-day boundary certificate produce three selected assignments and two certificate identities at horizon14. Expired material is separate, and the forty-five-day certificate joins only at horizon60.

review.purpose: Retain name scope when assignments collapse into one certificate-level planning item.
review.finding: All six fixtures carry one SAN entry. The work list retains the shared-soon and boundary names alongside their fingerprints and assignment lists; SAN presence is not a hostname-validation result.

review.purpose: Establish whether the supplied material fits this leaf-certificate planning narrative while retaining all observed certificates.
review.finding: The returned flags classify all six observed certificates as leaves, so this example does not model CA rotation. Missing material has no parsed profile and is not counted as a leaf.

review.purpose: Carry actual public-key type into the certificate-level handoff context.
review.finding: The six parsed keys are Ed25519 and the selected work list retains that type. This describes the fixture inventory, not an algorithm recommendation or a requirement to reuse an existing key.
